requested_order.text: Wegovy (semaglutide) 0.25 mg SC once weekly x4 weeks, then titrate per label to 2.4 mg weekly

adjunct_diet_and_activity.text:
A/P:
1. Class III obesity, BMI 43.5 — starting today:
 - Mediterranean-style reduced-calorie diet, target ~1800 kcal/day; cut all sugar-sweetened drinks.
 - Stationary bike at home 30–40 minutes, 4 days a week (albuterol beforehand as needed).
 - Referred to the clinic's Healthy Weight lifestyle program; RD intake to be scheduled.
 Follow-up in ~3 months.
2. HTN — BP 132/79 on lisinopril 10 mg; continue.
3. Migraine — sumatriptan PRN, ~1/month.

NUTRITION CONSULT — INITIAL
Date: 07/08/2025
Healthy Weight program intake. Food log: fast food 1–2x/day, 3–4 regular sodas, energy drinks on night shifts, rarely eats vegetables.
Plan: Mediterranean-style reduced-calorie eating at ~1800 kcal/day; replace soda/energy drinks with water or zero-calorie drinks; pack a lunch 3 shifts/week; add a vegetable to dinner daily; grilled instead of fried when eating out.
Activity: stationary bike 30–40 min, 4 days/week.
RD follow-up in ~6 weeks, program classes every other week.

NUTRITION FOLLOW-UP
Date: 01/14/2026
Food log reviewed: adherent most days, ~1800–1900 kcal. Still off soda and energy drinks. Fast food down to ~2x/week.
Small adjustments: protein-forward shift snacks (jerky, Greek yogurt), smaller rice portions, plan for holiday leftovers.
Reports keeping up with the stationary bike ~4 days/week.
Continue program.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 08/14/2026
S: Follow-up weight and BP. Continues the diet and exercise plan and program follow-ups for over a year now. Still off sugary drinks, packing meals, biking ~4 days a week. Frustrated — weight 119.4 kg today vs 122.8 kg in June 2025 when he started (-2.8%) despite reported adherence. Asks about medication. No MTC/MEN2 history, no pancreatitis. Migraines stable.
O: Wt 119.4 kg, BMI 42.3. BP 135/81.

A/P:
1. Class III obesity, BMI 42.3 — minimal response to a year of lifestyle changes. Start semaglutide 2.4 mg weekly (Wegovy) with standard dose titration; counseled on GI side effects, hydration (hx kidney stone), and small meals. Continue diet and bike plan. Recheck in 3 months.
2. Hypertension — BP 135/81 on lisinopril 10 mg daily; continue.
